about: A comparison that finds every candidate better: every check that must refuse fails.

mutations.find: export const verdictOf = (e) => ((c) => ((row) => ({ verdict: row.verdict, because: row.because(c), regressions: c.regressions }))(COMPARE.find((r) => r.when(c))))(factsOf(e));
mutations.replace: export const verdictOf = () => ({ verdict: "BETTER", because: "every candidate is better", regressions: [] });
